title: Bad Sign

lines.text: I was laying on the floor when you were gone
Like it was something I could die from
Now my headaches and your friends all think I'm dumb
You said it's just a bit of bad blood
Now I feel great, but it doesn't bother me
'Cause I don't have the energy
And the x-ray doesn't tell me a thing
Show me what the hell you see in me
You're lying
Now I guess it was a bad sign
I was praying to the Lord for some fun
Boy, I guess you didn't have some
I'm betraying everything that I've become
Just to prove it wasn't true, I know
If I'm too late, we come and hurry me
Like a kid among the dying leaves
If my heart breaks, we drug and care mean
When we can talk about our chemistry, I'm ready
And now I guess it was a bad sign
And now I guess it was a bad sign
All my time has turned to day
All my bones have realigned
And now I guess it was a bad sign
And now I guess it was a bad sign
And now I guess it was a bad sign
